axis_convention: HDF5 references have shape [recording_column=2, ROI_row=214]; MATLAB struct shape is [214,2]. Column 1 search, column 2 experimental; iResp is MATLAB one-based ROI rows.
response_cell_convention: Nested t/rats cells store HDF5 [epoch=2, singleton=1], MATLAB [1,2]; MATLAB epoch 1 is dark and epoch 2 light per README. Output descriptors contain no response values.

search_experimental_difference_interpret: ROI mask indices need not identify the same physical cell across separately processed recordings. Preserve differing local indices; do not treat equality or inequality as cell tracking.
limitations: Fly is the biological unit; ROIs, both polarities, repeated fields and search/experimental records within a fly are dependent. Series prefixes and numeric flyID namespaces require reconciliation before this release can support a physical-fly split.
This acquisition is untreated L2 ASAP2f female physiology; transfer to male anatomy and fluorescence-to-voltage/release mappings remain assumptions.
No aggregate response computation or GitHub aggregate correspondence check was performed, so provenance of highLum/lowLum aggregate curves is unresolved.
Timing descriptors and finite-value checks are metadata quality checks, not physiological model validation.
Scope excludes raw microscopy ZIP archives and other genotypes, drug conditions and naturalistic MAT files.

preliminary_attempt.limitation: Superseded descriptive attempt compared global numeric flyID incorrectly with the local filename suffix and sampled only the Windows launcher RSS. Its output is preserved; do not use those mismatch counts or memory measurement.

resource_audit.scope: Spawned Python launcher plus all recursively discovered child processes; only this owned tree is terminated on a guard failure.
resource_audit.limitation: RSS is sampled, not an OS-enforced allocation limit; an unsampled transient peak is possible.
